text:
Ava: Kicking off prod deploy for autosuggest_v2. Feature flag autosuggest_v2 -> start 15% cohorts now. Slow-start warmup (5m) to prime caches.
Luis: ETA for full ramp?
Ava: Plan: 15% now -> 30% in 20m -> 60% in 40m -> 100% after validations. Rollback plan ready.
deploy-bot: Commit 1f3a9d deployed to canary. Started rollout: cohort A (15%). Health checks enabled.
Priya: Dash updated: https://grafana.company/board/auto-suggest (CTR, p95 latency, 5xx). Added a small eval set to detect quality regressions.
Samira: I'll watch p95 and error rate. If 5xx > 0.5% for 5m or p95 > 350ms, we pause and route back to autosuggest_v1.
Jordan (oncall): Oncall standing by. If we need fast rollback, I'll pin routing to v1 and disable the flag. Keep me in the loop.
Luis: Quick rollback steps (pre-agreed):
```
# disable flag immediately
/deploybot toggle autosuggest_v2 0 --actor @Luis --reason "rollback"
# pin model routing to v1
/routing pin model autosuggest v1 --duration 1h
```
Ava: Also: quality gate: if eval-set delta CTR < -3% over 15m window, hold and investigate.
Priya: Canary CTR dipped ~2.8% in last 10m for cohort A. Not over the threshold yet but small signal.
Samira: I'm seeing a 0.4% bump in 5xx from one downstream service in the same timeframe. Could be noise.
Luis: Hold at 15% for another 20m until we confirm. No further ramp.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused by policy: manual_hold=true. Next automatic step cancelled.
Ava: Acknowledged. Priya—can you run the automated A/B quality check against the saved prompt set? If it flags, we roll back.
Priya: Running now -> will post results in 10m.
Samira: I'll open a quick span trace on the failing requests and check backend saturation.
Priya: Results: eval delta CTR = -3.6% (15m window). Quality gate failed.
Luis: Ok trigger rollback. @deploy-bot run the rollback steps.
deploy-bot: Executing: /deploybot toggle autosuggest_v2 0 --actor @Luis --reason "quality_gate_fail"
deploy-bot: Routing pinned back to autosuggest v1. All cohorts drained from v2. Notifying infra.
Ava: Thanks team. Please note in release notes: autosuggest_v2 ramp paused + rollback due to quality regression, timestamped and flagged for postmortem if needed.
Jordan (oncall): Monitoring post-rollback health. No new errors observed so far.
Priya: Filing a short follow-up thread with evaluation details and sample prompts.
Samira: I'll add traces and suspected downstream link. Might be an interaction with recent cache invalidation.
Luis: Postmortem owners: Priya (quality), Samira (infra), Ava (release). Let's meet tomorrow 10am to triage and plan a safer slow ramp (smaller cohorts + longer soak).
Ava: Agreed. I'll update runbook with the extra slowstart step and stricter eval gate.
deploy-bot: Incident note added to deploy log: deploy 1f3a9d paused + rolled back at 3150002400.
Ava: Closing here — thanks :thumbsup:
